expected_behavior: A comment that only restates the code it sits on is deleted.
A comment that survives says why: a non-obvious choice, the source of a magic value, an invariant, or what breaks if the code changes.
A comment that a better name would make unnecessary is replaced by the better name.
A block that needs a paragraph of explanation is extracted into a named function, and the tests are run afterwards to show behaviour did not change.
Directives, license headers, shebangs and doc comments a tool consumes are never removed as noise.
